title: Highly efficient mechanochemical depolymerisation of bio-based polyethylene furanoate and polybutylene furanoate
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,3513-3519
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00428D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Divya Jain, Florian Cramer, Pauline Shamraienko, Hans-Joachim Drexler, Brigitte Voit, Torsten Beweries
We present a mechanochemical protocol for the efficient depolymerisation of bio-based poly(ethylene furanoate) (PEF) and poly(butylene furanoate) (PBF) as alternatives to commodity plastics such as poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET).
